scripts.build: pnpm --dir web build && node scripts/go.mjs build
scripts.check: pnpm --dir web check && node scripts/go.mjs vet
scripts.format: prettier --write package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml web/package.json web/index.html web/vite.config.ts web/tsconfig.json web/src scripts README.md
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: pnpm --dir web build && pnpm --dir cloudflare deploy
